lines.japanese: というわけで、夕方からのバイト──鷲介の職場にやってきた。
lines.english: And so I arrived for my evening job—at Shuusuke's workplace.

lines.japanese: 当初はここでのバイトを続けるつもりはなかった。そりゃそうだ。鷲介になりすましてオサレな店でヘラヘラ笑って働くなんてこと、俺には到底無理だと思った。
lines.english: At first, I'd had no intention of keeping this job. Of course I hadn't. There was no way I could impersonate Shuusuke, plaster on a grin, and work in some trendy restaurant.

lines.japanese: ただ、あのヤロウが世話になった職場だ。いつか会ったヒゲのマスターに、無断退職などという不義理は果たしたくなかった。
lines.english: But this was a workplace that had taken care of the bastard. I didn't want to betray the bearded manager I'd met before by quitting without a word.

lines.japanese: そこで１２月のある日、俺は退職の意思を伝えるため、千歳鷲介としてアレキサンダー柳木原店の軽部店長を訪ねた。
lines.english: So one day in December, I went to see Manager Karube of Alexander's Yanagihara branch, posing as Shuusuke Chitose so I could tell him I was quitting.

lines.japanese: 「なに、俺に抱かれたがってる女がいる？」
lines.english: “What? There's a woman begging me to take her?”

lines.japanese: 「言ってねえよ」
lines.english: “Didn't say that.”

lines.japanese: おっさんはいきなりトバしていた。俺は条件反射でつい無礼にツッコんでしまった。
lines.english: The old man had come out swinging. My reflexive retort was ruder than I'd intended.

lines.japanese: このヒゲ店長の子供みたいな大らかさは、どこか俺の恩師を思いださせる。
lines.english: There was something about this bearded manager's childlike generosity that reminded me of my old mentor.

lines.japanese: そういえばあのじいさんも、笑えやしない冗談を連発してはよく俺たちを呆れさせていたものだ。
lines.english: Come to think of it, that geezer had exasperated us plenty by rattling off jokes nobody could laugh at.

lines.japanese: 「なに、バイトを辞めたい？」
lines.english: “What? You want to quit?”

lines.japanese: おっさんはやり直した。
lines.english: The old man started over.

lines.japanese: 「スイマセン」
lines.english: “Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 俺は深く頭を下げたが、言葉は簡素なものを選んだ。あの時点ではまだ、喋るなら千歳鷲介を演じる必要があった。
lines.english: I bowed deeply but kept my words simple. At that point, speaking meant I still had to play Shuusuke Chitose.

lines.japanese: 「ふむ。もともと鷲介には、短期間のヘルプという条件でこちらが無理を押した形だ。これ以上引きとめる権利はないのかもしれんが──」
lines.english: “Hmm. I was the one who pressed Shuusuke into helping us for a limited time. Perhaps I have no right to keep you any longer, but—”

lines.japanese: 「──しかし差し支えなければ、続けられなくなった理由ぐらいは教えてもらいたいものだな」
lines.english: “—if it isn't a problem, I'd at least like to know why you can no longer continue.”

lines.japanese: 「いや……まあ……」
lines.english: “Well... You see...”

lines.japanese: 俯いたまま言葉を濁した。ヒゲ店長が本当にあのじいさんみたいなやつなら、それが口外したくない理由であることぐらい、こんな態度で察してくれるだろう。
lines.english: I kept my head lowered and my answer vague. If the bearded manager really was like that old man, this ought to tell him I had reasons I couldn't share.

lines.japanese: 「なに、玉泉君の制服を着用して鏡に向かって罵りちらす一人プレイを目撃された？」
lines.english: “What? Someone caught you wearing Miss Tamaizumi's uniform and screaming abuse at yourself in the mirror?”

lines.japanese: 「言ってねえよ」
lines.english: “Didn't say that.”

lines.japanese: やっぱり察してくれた。おっさんはスベると分かりきった寒い下ネタで、厄介な話を流してくれた。
lines.english: He'd understood after all. The old man used a frigid dirty joke he knew would bomb to steer us away from an awkward subject.

lines.japanese: しかし──
lines.english: But then—

lines.japanese: 「そーゆわけなんで。世話ンなりました」
lines.english: “So, yeah. Thanks for everything.”

lines.japanese: ──席を立ち、素早く退室しようとしたそのとき。やつが不意に言った。
lines.english: —I stood and made to leave as quickly as possible, only for him to speak without warning.

lines.japanese: 「ところで鷲介はどこにいるんだ？」
lines.english: “By the way, where is Shuusuke?”

lines.japanese: 数歩分の距離がありながら、まるで肩を掴んで止められたようだった。
lines.english: We were several paces apart, yet it felt as if a hand had seized my shoulder and stopped me.

lines.japanese: 表情にも出てしまったんだろう。ヒゲ店長は鋭く目を光らせて静かに笑った。
lines.english: My face must have betrayed me. The bearded manager's eyes sharpened as he smiled quietly.

lines.japanese: 「そんなに驚くなよ。俺の目は尻穴じゃない、おまえが千歳鷲介じゃないってことぐらいは分かるさ」
lines.english: “Don't look so surprised. I've got eyes in my head, not my ass. I can tell you're not Shuusuke Chitose.”
“What...?”

lines.japanese: 「昔ちょいとおかしな世界に生きてたもんでな。その頃の名残りで、女の外面にはこだわるが、男に関しちゃあ中身しか見ないことにしている」
lines.english: “I used to live in a strange little world. Old habits die hard: I care about a woman's exterior, but with a man, I look only at what's inside.”

lines.japanese: おっさんは俺から目を逸らして、くちびるに煙草を挿した。
lines.english: The old man looked away from me and put a cigarette between his lips.

lines.japanese: ハードボイルドな着火音。やつはニコチンを一口摂ってから、ふたたび俺の深淵を正面から覗きこんだ。
lines.english: His lighter clicked with a hard-boiled snap. After one dose of nicotine, he turned back and peered straight into my depths.

lines.japanese: 「おまえに会うのはこれが初めてじゃないよな、鷲介のそっくりさん。少し前から薄々勘付いてはいた。おまえのことはなんと呼べばいいんだ？」
lines.english: “This isn't our first meeting, is it, Shuusuke's double? I've had my suspicions for a while. What should I call you?”

lines.japanese: じいさんと同じ、あらゆる不安を包容する瞳が、にわかに俺の警戒心を融かしてゆく。
lines.english: His eyes were like the old man's, capable of embracing every anxiety. My guard abruptly began to melt.

lines.japanese: 「……成田隼人」
lines.english: “...Hayato Narita.”

lines.japanese: 気付けば俺はソファーに座りなおして告げていた。
lines.english: Before I knew it, I had sat back down on the couch and answered him.

lines.japanese: 「ＯＫ、ハヤト。鷲介は出てこられないのか」
lines.english: “Okay, Hayato. Shuusuke can't come out?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、まァ」
lines.english: “Yeah... Well.”

lines.japanese: 「そうか……あいつめ、長い旅にでも出たかな……」
lines.english: “I see... The rascal gone off on a long journey?”

lines.japanese: 「ん……そんなとこっす……」
lines.english: “Mm... Something like that...”

lines.japanese: 俺は謝るように項垂れた。おっさんはしばらくの間、言葉もなく煙草を吹かしていた。
lines.english: I hung my head as if apologizing. For a while, the old man smoked without another word.

lines.japanese: ヤニ臭くなった部屋に、先の読めない沈黙がたちこめる。
lines.english: An unreadable silence settled over the room as it filled with the reek of tobacco.

lines.japanese: 軽部狩男。鳳（兄）からタダ者じゃないとは聞いていたが、たしかにキレるやつだ。カタギの目じゃねえ。
lines.english: Karuo Karube. Naru's brother had told me the man was no ordinary civilian, and he really was sharp. Those weren't the eyes of an honest working stiff.

lines.japanese: その卓越した洞察力は、これまで隠しとおしてきた俺たちの真実に辿りつき、すべてを看破していた。
lines.english: His remarkable insight had reached the truth we'd kept hidden all this time and seen through everything.

lines.japanese: 「しかしまさか鷲介に双子の兄がいたとはなあ」
lines.english: “Still, I never imagined Shuusuke had a twin brother.”

lines.japanese: いや、すべて見抜いたわけじゃなかったみたいだ。
lines.english: Apparently he hadn't seen through everything.

lines.japanese: 「苗字が違うってことは、離れて暮らしてる兄弟なのか」
lines.english: “Different last names, huh? So you’re brothers who live apart?”

lines.japanese: 察しがいいのか悪いのか、微妙なおっさんだな。
lines.english: I couldn't decide whether the old man was perceptive or hopeless.

lines.japanese: 「そんでそんで？　鷲介は旅行ってどこ行ってんの？」
lines.english: “So? So? Where'd Shuusuke go on his trip?”

lines.japanese: つか、旅に出たっていうの、たとえ話じゃなかったのかよ。
lines.english: Wait, had the journey thing not been a metaphor?

lines.japanese: 「ねえねえ、鷲介お土産にアレ買ってきてくれるかなあ。ホラあるじゃん、こうさ、こうやって傾けると、金髪美女がすっぽんぽんになるボールペン」
lines.english: “Hey, you think he'll bring me one of those souvenir pens? You know, the ones where you tilt them and the blond beauty's clothes disappear?”

lines.japanese: 「さあ……無理じゃないすか……」
lines.english: “Who knows... Probably not...”

lines.japanese: どこまで本気で言ってるんだろう。読めないおっさんだった。
lines.english: I couldn't tell how much of this he meant. The old man was impossible to read.

lines.japanese: というわけで。
lines.english: And so—

lines.japanese: なんとなく鷲介の兄弟ということになった俺は、なんとなく鷲介と入れ替わりで働くことになった。
lines.english: somehow I became Shuusuke's brother, and somehow I wound up taking his place at work.

lines.japanese: 受験休み中の望月が戻ってくる３月までは、なにかと人手不足だから手伝ってほしいと泣きつかれたのだ。
lines.english: They were short-handed and begged me to help until Mochizuki returned from exam leave in March.

lines.japanese: 歳のわりにバイト経験豊富な俺だが、しかし、接客業だけは避けてきた領域だった。
lines.english: For my age, I'd worked an impressive number of part-time jobs. Customer service was the one field I'd always avoided.

lines.japanese: 千歳鷲介としての経験が多少記憶としてあると言え、こればっかりは成田隼人たる俺の資質の問題だ。
lines.english: I possessed some memory of Shuusuke's experience, but this came down to my own aptitude as Hayato Narita.

lines.japanese: 裏方作業ならまだしも、フロアでお客さまにヘーコラなんて、正直まっとうにやれる自信がない。俺はあらかじめヒゲ店長にその旨を告げた。
lines.english: Back-room work was one thing. I had no confidence I could bow and scrape to customers out on the floor. I warned the bearded manager in advance.

lines.japanese: 「なに、性に目覚めた女子高生が初体験を焦って俺と火遊びしたがっている？」
lines.english: “What? A high-school girl awakening to her sexuality is desperate to lose her virginity and wants an affair with me?”

lines.japanese: 「言ってねえっつうの」
lines.english: “I didn't fucking say that.”

lines.japanese: おっさんは常にトバしていた。ゆえに俺は、基本的に敬語ながらツッコミだけは容赦なく行かせてもらうことにした。
lines.english: The old man always came out swinging. So although I generally spoke politely to him, I decided my retorts would show no mercy.

lines.japanese: 「なに、接客業は自信がない？」
lines.english: “What? You aren't confident in customer service?”

lines.japanese: おっさんはやり直した。
lines.english: The old man started over.

lines.japanese: 「ああ、そんなことなら安心しろ。本部の意向でな、新人スタッフには必ずひとり、教育係を当てることになっている」
lines.english: “Oh, don't worry about that. Head office policy requires every new employee to have a dedicated trainer.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえの担当になる女性スタッフは、気が滅入るほど真面目で、逃げだしたくなるほど神経質なやつだ。きっと一人前のウェイターに育ててもらえるぞ、はっはっは」
lines.english: “The woman assigned to you is so serious it'll depress you and so neurotic you'll want to run away. I'm sure she'll shape you into a proper waiter. Ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: 「そうすか……」
lines.english: “Right...”

lines.japanese: 俺の魂の鷲介的な部分がぶるぶる震えていた。
lines.english: The Shuusuke part of my soul trembled violently.

lines.japanese: 「おっと！　すまん隼人、ちょっと待ってくれ」
lines.english: “Oh! Sorry, Hayato. Hold on a moment.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「アーアー、ん、んんっ、ごほん」
lines.english: “Aah, aah. Mm, mmm. Ahem.”

lines.japanese: 「なに、セックスレスに悩む団地妻がときおり俺の後ろ姿をもの欲しそうに見詰めている？」
lines.english: “What? A sexually frustrated housewife from the apartment complex sometimes gazes longingly at my back?”

lines.japanese: 「いいから。やり直さなくていいから。編集点も作んなくていいから」
lines.english: “Enough. You don't need to start over. And quit making clean edit points.”

lines.japanese: というわけで、俺はこの店でアルバイトを続けていた。
lines.english: And that was how I came to keep working at this restaurant.

lines.japanese: もっとも、担当教官の方針とやらで、勤務時間の半分ぐらいは分厚いマニュアルを読んで終わる。
lines.english: Granted, under my instructor's policy, I spent about half each shift reading a thick manual.

lines.japanese: 鷲介が一度読破しているものだが、教官からすれば俺とやつはまったくの別人なのだから仕方ない。
lines.english: Shuusuke had already read the whole thing once, but to my instructor, he and I were entirely different people. It couldn't be helped.

lines.japanese: それでも鷲介のころよりは締め付けが緩くなったはずだ。やつの記憶によれば、そのときの俺は一日中マニュアル漬けだったのだから。
lines.english: Even so, she had to be less strict than she'd been with Shuusuke. According to his memories, I'd spent all day buried in the manual back then.

lines.japanese: 鬼教官のかたくななタマイズムを、いかなる所以が緩和せしめたのか。答えは鷲介も知らない。
lines.english: What had softened our demon instructor's stubborn Tama-ism? Not even Shuusuke knew the answer.

lines.japanese: 「うーす千歳、久しぶりじゃーん」
lines.english: “Yo, Chitose! Long time no see.”

lines.japanese: 正面入口から店に入ると、先輩バイトの日野が鷲介の名を呼んでやってきた。
lines.english: When I entered through the front door, Hino, one of the senior part-timers, came over calling me by Shuusuke's name.

lines.japanese: ああ、そういや俺、今日は糞ワシの服を借りてたんだ。
lines.english: Oh, right. I was wearing that asshole Shuu's clothes today.

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちげくて……」
lines.english: “No, you've got it wrong...”

lines.japanese: 億劫な訂正をしようとしたら、横から現れた常連客に先を越された。
lines.english: I was about to make the tiresome correction when a regular customer appeared beside us and beat me to it.

lines.japanese: 「ヒノエリ、そいつ隼人」
lines.english: “Hinoeri, that's Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「え、マジで？　うそ、おまえ成田？」
lines.english: “Huh, seriously? No way. You're Narita?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、めちゃめちゃ成田じゃん」
lines.english: “I'm obviously Narita.”

lines.japanese: 俺は胸を反らして顎を振る。頭のてっぺんから爪先まで、日野の視線が遠慮なくなぞっていった。
lines.english: I puffed out my chest and jerked up my chin. Hino's gaze traveled shamelessly from the top of my head to my toes.

lines.japanese: 「分っかんねぇー。やっぱおまえも千歳も、見た目変わんねーじゃん」
lines.english: “I can't tell! You and Chitose still look exactly the same.”

lines.japanese: 「目ェ見りゃ一発だよ。他人が恐くて嫌われないようにヘラヘラしてんのがシュウちゃん、他人が恐くてナメられないようにブスッとしてんのが隼人」
lines.english: “Look at their eyes. Shuu's scared of people, so he grins to keep them from hating him. Hayato's scared of people, so he scowls to keep them from looking down on him.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。すんな、俺らを分析すんな」
lines.english: “Shut up. Don't analyze us.”

lines.japanese: 「あれえ、図星突いちゃった？　じゃあ、他人が恐くないアイツに替わればっていうか替われよ凡人」
lines.english: “Aww, hit a nerve? Why don’t you switch with the one who isn’t scared of people? Actually, just switch, Mr. Average.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせっつんだよ。しゃべんな糞ニワトリ」
lines.english: “Shut up. Quit talking, you fucking chicken.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なに替わるって。カケル、なにそれ」
lines.english: “Huh? What do you mean, switch? Kakeru, what's that about?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでもねえよ。ちょっと向こう行ってろ、糞マツゲ」
lines.english: “Nothing. Go over there, you damn eyelashes.”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　なんだ？　てめえはいつからそんな偉そうなクチ利くようになったんだ、ええ？」
lines.english: “Oh? Since when did you start talking so big, huh?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いて、痛てえっつの。てめ、男の子のアタマお盆でボンボン叩くんじゃねえよ、ブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Ow! That hurts! Quit playing bongos on a guy’s head with that tray, you asshole! I’ll fucking kill you!”

lines.japanese: 「わはは、千歳顔で凄まれてもぜんぜん恐くねぇー！」
lines.english: “Wahaha! You aren't scary at all with Chitose's face!”

lines.japanese: 「く、くそ、とんでもねえ女だ……」
lines.english: “D-damn it. What the hell is wrong with this woman...?”

lines.japanese: 女子供相手に力で対抗するわけにもいかない。威嚇の通用しなかった俺は、日野のシルバートレイ攻撃からみっともなく逃げだした。
lines.english: I couldn't fight back with force against a woman. With my attempts at intimidation useless, I fled Hino's silver-tray assault in disgrace.

lines.japanese: 「隼人よえー」
lines.english: “Hayato's so weak.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせ、どけ。俺はもう着替えて働く」
lines.english: “Shut up and move. I'm getting changed so I can work.”

lines.japanese: 「やっぽーん！　千歳君、おひさしぶーりん！」
lines.english: “Yappoon! Chitose! Long time no see-rino!”
“Huh?”

lines.japanese: 今度は常連客の望月が現れた。
lines.english: This time, another regular, Mochizuki, appeared.

lines.japanese: またかよ。また糞ワシと間違われてンじゃねえか。
lines.english: Again? Another person had mistaken me for that asshole Shuu.

lines.japanese: 「ああ紀奈子さん。その千歳、成田だって」
lines.english: “Oh, Kinako. That Chitose is actually Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、そうなの？　成田君？」
lines.english: “Huh? Really? Narita?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、バリバリ成田じゃん」
lines.english: “I'm obviously Narita.”

lines.japanese: 俺は胸を反らして顎を振る。頭のてっぺんから爪先まで、望月の視線が遠慮なくなぞっていった。
lines.english: I puffed out my chest and jerked up my chin. Mochizuki's gaze traveled shamelessly from the top of my head to my toes.

lines.japanese: 「はー、どっから見ても千歳君そっくりだけどねえ」
lines.english: “Wow. You look exactly like Chitose from every angle.”

lines.japanese: さらに後ろへ周りこんでは、あらゆる角度から観察している。うざくなって、俺は手を横に払った。
lines.english: She even circled around behind me to inspect me from every direction. Annoyed, I shooed her away with one hand.

lines.japanese: 「見んな。ジロジロ見んな」
lines.english: “Stop looking. Quit staring at me.”

lines.japanese: 「ええー？　成田君って意外と照れ屋さん？」
lines.english: “Huh? Are you surprisingly shy, Narita?”

lines.japanese: 「隼人は根が単純だから、反応もストレートなんだよねえ。いろいろ企むシュウちゃんより、よっぽど扱いやすいよ」
lines.english: “Hayato's simple deep down, so his reactions are straightforward. Much easier to handle than Shuu and all his schemes.”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえ、照れるとか照れないとか、そういうこっちゃねえんだよ。糞イチゴてめ調子こいて、いつまでもヒトにガンたれてんじゃねーつってんの」
lines.english: “Shut up. This isn't about being shy. And you, Strawberry, don't get cocky and stand there staring me down.”

lines.japanese: 「きゃああ、千歳君の顔でツッパってるカワイイ～！」
lines.english: “Awww! Acting tough with Chitose's face is so cute!”

lines.japanese: 「うるせ、どけ。俺はもう着替えて働く」
lines.english: “Shut up and move. I'm getting changed so I can work.”

lines.japanese: 「おう、久しぶりだな鷲介。おまえが海外旅行してるあいだに日本では、階段をのぼるときミニスカートの裾を押さえるの禁止法案が可決されたぞ」
lines.english: “Hey, Shuusuke. Long time no see. While you were overseas, Japan passed a law banning girls from holding down their miniskirts when they climb stairs.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ店長。その千歳君、成田君だって」
lines.english: “Oh, Manager. That Chitose is actually Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「む、そうなのか？」
lines.english: “Hmm? Is that so?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、明らかに成田じゃん」
lines.english: “I'm obviously Narita.”

lines.japanese: 俺は胸を反らして顎を振る。頭のてっぺんから爪先まで、ヒゲ店長の視線が遠慮なくなぞっていった。
lines.english: I puffed out my chest and jerked up my chin. The bearded manager's gaze traveled shamelessly from the top of my head to my toes.

lines.japanese: 「ううむ、いつもと変わり映えのない粗末な股間だがなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm. The package is as unimpressive as ever.”

lines.japanese: 「どこ見てんだよ」
lines.english: “Where the hell are you looking?”

lines.japanese: 「ははは、鷲介の粗末な股間で迫られてもまったく嬉しくないな」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Having Shuusuke's unimpressive package thrust at me does nothing at all.”

lines.japanese: もはやどこからツッコんで良いやら分からなかった。
lines.english: I no longer knew where to begin with the retorts.

lines.japanese: 「うるせ、どけ。俺はもう行く」
lines.english: “Shut up and move. I'm going.”

lines.japanese: 「あの、皆さん。入口の前で固まってるの異様な光景なんで、そろそろ散ってもらえませんか」
lines.english: “Excuse me, everyone. You all look ridiculous huddled in front of the entrance, so could you please clear out?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ玉泉君。その陰茎、いつもと変わらず今日も粗末らしいぞ」
lines.english: “Ah, Miss Tamaizumi. Apparently his penis is every bit as unimpressive today as usual.”

lines.japanese: 「わけの分からないこと言ってないで、早く仕事してください。成田さんも早く着替えて」
lines.english: “Stop talking nonsense and get to work. Narita, please hurry up and change.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ！」
lines.english: “What?!”

lines.japanese: 「すげー、なんでなんで！？　たまひよ、見ただけで千歳か成田か分かんの？」
lines.english: “Whoa! How? Why? Tama-chick, you can tell Chitose and Narita apart just by looking?”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「え、だって、どう見ても千歳さんとは別人じゃないですか」
lines.english: “I mean, he's obviously a different person from Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「どこが！？」
lines.english: “Where?!”

lines.japanese: 「うーん、顔付きとか、立ち方……とか？　とにかく、ぜんぜん千歳さんじゃないですよ」
lines.english: “Well, his expression, the way he stands... I suppose? At any rate, he looks nothing like Chitose.”

lines.japanese: 「うそぉ、そんな違うー？」
lines.english: “Seriously? They're that different?”

lines.japanese: 「と言われても、ううむ、千歳鷲介の姿など観察したところで股の足しにもならんからな。正直そんな見た覚えがない」
lines.english: “Well, I gain nothing in the crotch from studying Shuusuke Chitose's appearance, so I honestly can't say I remember looking.”

lines.japanese: 「タマイズミは近眼のくせに、シュウちゃんのことよく見てたんだねえ」
lines.english: “Tamaizumi's nearsighted, but she sure watched Shuu closely.”

lines.japanese: 「べつに見たくて見てるわけじゃありません。担当教官という立場上、彼の振る舞いを監視する機会がひとより多いってだけです」
lines.english: “It isn't because I wanted to watch him. As his instructor, I simply had more opportunities than most to monitor his conduct.”

lines.japanese: 「にしたって、ふたりそんな違う？　同じじゃん。なんか眠そうな目ェして、こう、ダルンダルンな姿勢でさあ」
lines.english: “Still, are they really that different? They look the same. Sleepy eyes and this limp, slouching posture.”

lines.japanese: 「ああいえ、実は千歳さん、ああ見えて意外と立ち方綺麗なんですよ」
lines.english: “Actually, Chitose stands surprisingly well despite how he looks.”

lines.japanese: 「背筋伸ばしてピッとしてる感じじゃないんですけど、四肢の曲げ方に流れがあるっていうか。モデルみたいに、ゆったりした姿勢が様になってるんですよね」
lines.english: “His back isn't ramrod straight or anything, but there's a sort of flow to the way he bends his limbs. He makes a relaxed pose look natural, like a model.”

lines.japanese: 「あー、そうかも。じっとしてるときの千歳君は、たまに色気みたいのあるよね」
lines.english: “Oh, I see what you mean. When Chitose stands still, he sometimes has this air of sex appeal.”

lines.japanese: 「んん……まあ、じっとしてるとき限定なら、分からなくもないか……」
lines.english: “Hmm... Yes, if we're limiting this strictly to when he stands still, I can understand...”

lines.japanese: 「そうよね。たしかに千歳君と軽部君は、匂いたつ男の色気がムンムンしてるわよね」
lines.english: “Exactly. Chitose and Karube simply reek of masculine sex appeal.”

lines.japanese: 「分かるー。チョー分かるー。軽部君サイコー、抱かれた～い」
lines.english: “Totally! I so get it! Karube's the best. I want him to take me!”

lines.japanese: 「な、なんですって！　軽部君は私のものよ、あんたなんかこうしてやるわムキーっ！」
lines.english: “W-what did you say?! Karube is mine! I'll show you, you little—raaar!”

lines.japanese: 「成田君、千歳君はいつ帰ってくるの？」
lines.english: “Narita, when is Chitose coming back?”

lines.japanese: 「さあ」
lines.english: “Who knows.”

lines.japanese: そろそろ真実を語るころだとは思っている。
lines.english: I knew it was about time I told them the truth.

lines.japanese: しかし、今それを告げるのはためらわれた。
lines.english: But I couldn't bring myself to tell them now.

lines.japanese: 「えー、つまんなーい。千歳君、はやく帰ってきてくれないかなあ」
lines.english: “Aww, boring. I wish Chitose would hurry home.”

lines.japanese: 「ねー。あいついないと退屈だよねー」
lines.english: “Yeah. It's dull without him around.”

lines.japanese: 「そうですね。いてくれれば猫の手よりは助かりますけど」
lines.english: “Well, even his help would be better than no help at all.”

lines.japanese: へえ。
lines.english: Huh.

lines.japanese: 鷲介だった俺は、どうやら自分で思っていたよりもこの場に馴染めていたみたいだ。
lines.english: Apparently the Shuusuke I'd been had fit in here better than I'd realized.

lines.japanese: 「ううむ、相方がいないと俺の爆笑おいろけ漫談もいまいちウケが悪くてなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm. Without my partner, my hilarious risqué comedy routine doesn't land nearly as well.”

lines.japanese: 「私も千歳君に聞いてもらいたい愚痴いっぱいあるのになあ」
lines.english: “I have so many complaints I wanted Chitose to hear.”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱ、ああいうノリのやつ一人はほしいよね。遊びに限らず、仕事でも何でもさ」
lines.english: “You need at least one guy with that kind of energy around, right? For work and play and everything else.”

lines.japanese: 「ええ、勤務態度は真面目でしたから、仕事面においては期待しています」
lines.english: “Yes. His attitude on the job was serious, so in terms of work, I expect a great deal from him.”

lines.japanese: へえー。
lines.english: Huh.

lines.japanese: そうなんだ。そうだったんだ。
lines.english: So that was how it was. I had never known.

lines.japanese: 「おい隼人、今度やつから国際電話でもあったら、早く帰ってこいと伝えてくれ。従業員一同からの切なる願いだ」
lines.english: “Hey, Hayato. Next time he calls from overseas, tell him to hurry home. Consider it the heartfelt plea of the entire staff.”

lines.japanese: 「さーせん。自分、着替えてくンで」
lines.english: “Sorry. I'm gonna go change.”

lines.japanese: なんだか目が無駄に潤んできたので、俺は強引に道を空けさせてその場を逃げた。
lines.english: My eyes had started watering for no good reason, so I forced them to clear a path and escaped.

lines.japanese: さっさと準備して、さっさと仕事を始めよう。
lines.english: Time to get ready and get to work.

lines.japanese: ちょっと今日はぬるっと行きたい気分だ。
lines.english: Today, I felt like keeping it slippery.

lines.japanese: 「良かったねえ、シュウちゃん。たまには帰ってくればいいのに」
lines.english: “Good for you, Shuu. You oughta come back once in a while.”

lines.japanese: 「何いってんのカケル、あいつ成田だって」
lines.english: “What're you talking about, Kakeru? That was Narita.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、間違えちゃったあ」
lines.english: “Oh. My mistake.”
